requirement.value: Sensitive (Esper), Elementalist, Entropist or Spiritist mastery

system.description: While you are in Crisis, you are flying: your melee attacks can target flying creatures, and melee cannot reach you unless the attacker flies or can otherwise reach flying targets. Suspended whenever you cannot fly freely — inside a vehicle built for human-sized creatures, in a narrow corridor — and lost until the start of your next turn if you suffer air, earth or light damage in a conflict. Flight in public view ticks the Miasma Clock by 1; used in a cellar, in the works, or at night with nobody watching, it costs nothing. Not the cut Skilled Sinning: two heroics in that book share the name, the Sinner's dies with its class, and this is the other one. The rename ends the collision.
